HPCL-FTX-0001.title: HP Milcy  Futur-X 15W-40
HPCL-FTX-0001.description: HP MILCY FUTUR-X 15W-40 is a super-premium quality diesel engine oil formulated with high quality paraffinic base stocks and state-of-the-art additive technology. It is specifically designed for modern low-emission diesel engines equipped with After-Treatment Devices such as Diesel Particulate Filter (DPF), Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR), Cooled EGR, and Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR). HP MILCY FUTUR-X 15W-40 is formulated on a low-SAPS platform to provide enhanced protection against oil oxidation, viscosity loss due to shear, oil aeration, catalyst poisoning, particulate filter blocking, engine wear, piston deposits, degradation of low- and high temperature properties, and soot-related viscosity increase. Its excellent high-temperature oxidation stability helps extend oil drain intervals. The product’s exceptional soot dispersancy controls oil thickening and filter clogging, while its advanced detergency ensures superior piston cleanliness.
HPCL-FTX-0001.appData: HP MILCY FUTUR-X 15W-40 is recommended for new-generation BS-VI diesel engines in heavy commercial vehicles, multi-utility vehicles, and small diesel cars equipped with DPF, EGR/Cooled EGR, or SCR after-treatment systems. It also delivers significant benefits in engine protection and oil life in regular BS-II/BS-III/BS-IV compliant engines requiring oils meeting API CF-4/CH-4/CI-4/CI-4 Plus performance levels. Additionally, the product is suitable for PHEV and HEV-type electric commercial vehicles

HPCL-FTX-0002.title: HP RACER FUTUR-X 10W 50
HPCL-FTX-0002.description: HP RACER FUTUR-X 10W 50 is a premium quality synthetic motor cycle engine oil made to cater to the highly demanding lubrication requirements of modern High Powered 4-Stroke geared bikes.HP RACER FUTUR-X 10W 50 is manufactured from a synergistic blend of high quality synthetic base stocks, esters and state of art additive technology to meet the requirements of API SP as well as JASO MA2 performance levels.HP RACER FUTUR-X 10W 50 provides superior protection for engine, clutch and gears of the high powered motor cycles. Advanced synthetic formula of HP RACER FUTUR-X 10W 50 renders exemplary performance benefits like unmatched engine and gear protection, low volatility that lowers the oil top-up needs, smooth clutch operation and longer oil drain interval.
HPCL-FTX-0002.appData: HP RACER FUTUR-X 10W 50 is recommended for high performance bikes, sport bikes, road bikes and trail bikes. Also, recommended for high powered bikes of KTM, Yamaha and Royal Enfield.

HPCL-FTX-0003.title: HP MILCY FUTUR-X 10W-30
HPCL-FTX-0003.description: HP MILCY FUTUR-X 10W-30 is a super-premium quality diesel engine oil made from the finest paraffinic base stocks and state of art additive technology, specifically for the modern low emission diesel engines, employing after treatment devices.HP MILCY FUTUR-X 10W-30 is designed on a low SAPS platform to provide fuel efficiency benefits and with exceptional low temperature performance. It enhances protection against oil oxidation, viscosity loss due to shear and oil aeration, as well as catalyst poisoning. The Low SAPS technology helps in preventing particulate filter blocking, engine wear, piston deposits, degradation of low- and high-temperature properties and soot-related viscosity increase. The high temperature oxidation stability will help in extending drain interval of the oil. While, its exceptional soot dispersancy provides optimum control on oil thickening & filter clogging; the advanced detergency in the product exhibits exemplary control on piston deposit.
HPCL-FTX-0003.appData: HP MILCY FUTUR-X 10W-30 grade is recommended for new generation BS VI diesel engines of heavy commercial, multi utility as well as small cars employing DPF, Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR)/ Cooled EGR/SCR type after treatment devices. The product also yields tangible benefits on longer engine oil life, better engine health in regular BS II/BS III/BS IV compliant engines requiring engine oil meeting API CF-4/CH-4/CI-4/CI-4 Plus performance level.

HPCL-FTX-0004.description: HP NEOSYNTH FUTUR-X 0W 16 grade is a super-premium synthetic engine oil based on advanced Low SAPS additive technology to deliver excellent performance in modern cars running on Petrol /CNG/E20 Fuel meeting BS VI emission norms.Recommended for various models of BS VI compliant passenger cars of Tata Motors, Maruti-Suzuki, Hyundai Motors, Renault, Nissan, Datsun, Chevrolet, Toyota, BMW, GM and Ford, etc. running on Petrol /CNG/E20 Fuel and requiring a SAE 0W-16 viscosity engine oil. Also recommended for PHEV & HEV type Electric Passenger Cars & SUVs.
